PLACED ONLY ON THE FRONT AND REAR OF A VEHICLE.

STOP ACCELERATING.
DOWNSHIFT.

opcionesEn: MOST PEOPLE ARE MORE ALERT AT NIGHT THAN DURING THE DAY.
MOST HAZARDS ARE EASIER TO SEE AT NIGHT THAN DURING THE DAY.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING ON A TWO-LANE ROAD. AN ONCOMING DRIVER DRIFTS INTO YOUR LANE AND IS HEADED STRAIGHT FOR YOU. WHICH OF THESE IS MOST OFTEN THE BEST ACTION TO TAKE.
opcionesEn: HARD BRAKING.
STEER TO THE RIGHT.
STEER ONTO THE LEFT SHOULDER.

opcionesEn: KEEP DRIVING, AND TURN YOUR DEFROSTER ON.
KEEP DRIVING AND SPRAY THE WINDSHIELD WITH WASHER FLUID.
STOP SAFELY AND FIX THE PROBLEM.

opcionesEn: ONLY WHEN YOU NEED TO BACK ON A CURVED PATH.
WHENEVER YOU HAVE TO BACK.
ONLY WHEN YOU HAVE A TRAILER ON YOUR VEHICLE.

opcionesEn: WAIT FOR QUIALIFIED FIREFIGHTERS.
USE WATER.

opcionesEn: HONK YOUR HORN AND STAY CLOSE BEHIND THE CAR.
SIGNAL AND CHANGE LANES TO AVOID HAZARD.
SLOW DOWN TO PREVENT A CRASH.

opcionesEn: 35 MPH.
45 MPH.
55 MPH.

preguntaEn: TO AVOID A CRASH, YOU HAD TO DRIVE INTO THE RIGHT SHOULDER. YOU ARE NOW DRIVING AT 40 MPH ON THE SHOULDER. HOW SHOULD YOU MOVE BACK ONTO THE PAVEMENT?
opcionesEn: IF THE SHOULDER IS CLEAR, STAY ON IT UNTIL YOUR VEHICLE HAS COME TO A STOP. THEN MOVE BACK ONTO THE PAVEMENT WHEN IT IS SAFE.
BRAKE HARD TO SLOW THE VEHICLE, THEN STEER SHARPLY ONTO THE PAVEMENT.
KEEP MOVING AT THE PRESENT SPEED AND STEER VERY GENTLY BACK ONTO THE PAVEMENT.

opcionesEn: BELOW, HIGHER.

THE VEHICLE DOES NOT REQUIRE PLACARDS.
THE PERSON WHO HAS HAZMAR ENDORSEMENT DRIVES WITH YOU.

YOUR BRAKE FLUID MAY BE LOW.

opcionesEn: NEVER DO IT WITHOUT DOWNSHIFTING FIRST.
IF THE WHEELS ARE SKIDDING, YOU CANNOT CONTROL YOUR VEHICLE.

opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD ADJUST YOUR MIRRORS BEFORE STARTING THE TRIP.
YOU CAN ADJUST YOUR MIRRORS WHILE YOU ARE DRIVING.

opcionesEn: THE COOLANT TEMPERATURE GAUGE SHOULD BE BEGIN A GRADUAL RISE TO NORMAL.

DRIVING IN THE CENTER LINE.
